hypothesis: Pretrain task-agnostic forward and backward policies for attachment-aware atom-and-fragment molecular graph construction, sample every proposal from an empty graph, and after oracle feedback optimize the policies and a learned partition function with trajectory-balance loss on reward-prioritized replay of only evaluated terminal graphs and their valid construction and deconstruction trajectories, using strictly positive tempered terminal rewards so learned flow concentrates on high-reward molecules across multiple routes.
method_thesis: Learn a task-agnostic forward and backward molecular-construction policy from the allowed unlabeled corpus using an atom-and-fragment graph grammar, then restart that policy independently for each objective. From an empty graph, the forward policy samples chemically valid attachment, bond, and stop actions until it produces a terminal molecule; whole corpus molecules are never retrieved, ranked, or used as a finite candidate pool. After each evaluator-announced batch is scored, map each observed score to a strictly positive tempered terminal reward and train on only oracle-evaluated molecules and their sampled construction/deconstruction trajectories using the trajectory-balance loss, a learned partition function, and reward-prioritized replay. Because trajectory balance assigns terminal probability according to total flow across every construction route rather than merely increasing the likelihood of one elite sequence, online feedback amortizes search into a de novo sampler whose probability mass concentrates on high-reward molecular regions while continuing to expose distinct routes to rare high-scoring structures. The optimization target remains the mean final Top-1 across the five independent sessions; flow statistics and replay usage are mechanism evidence, not substitute objectives.

activation_observables.measurement: For every online optimizer update, evaluate the identical replayed trajectories immediately before and after optimization and report the change in their mean squared residual of log Z plus summed forward log-probabilities minus log terminal reward minus summed backward log-probabilities, together with the number of finite-residual trajectories.

activation_observables.measurement: At every update with non-tied replay rewards, record the mean normalized terminal-reward rank percentile of sampled replay items minus its exact expectation under uniform sampling from the same eligible buffer, and aggregate the signed advantage across updates.

activation_observables.measurement: For every emitted terminal and every replay trajectory used for training, verify that each forward construction action and its paired reverse deconstruction action are legal under the recorded partial graphs and receive finite positive policy probability; report the supported fraction, action counts, and separate unsupported-forward and unsupported-backward counts relative to a zero-support baseline.

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus can be decomposed into enough valid atom-and-fragment construction trajectories to train chemically productive forward and backward policy priors without retaining whole corpus molecules as a proposal pool.

The graph grammar and attachment vocabulary assign nonzero support to useful molecules and preserve enough legal reverse actions for trajectory-balance learning across alternative construction orders.
Oracle scores contain enough variation within the evaluated replay buffer for the positive tempered reward transform and prioritized sampling to distinguish more promising terminals.

High-reward evaluated graphs share reusable partial-graph and attachment structure with reachable unseen graphs, so off-policy flow updates can improve subsequent empty-root samples within 29 adaptive feedback rounds.
Forward-policy construction, sanitization, and novelty filtering maintain sufficient yield to fill every evaluator-announced batch before the 3000-proposal safety limit.

The result may not transfer when the best chemistry lies outside the corpus-trained grammar, requires coordinated graph changes that have negligible forward-policy support, provides effectively tied or ultra-sparse rewards, or needs more replay updates than the 300-call session permits.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if emitted proposals cannot be traced from the empty graph through finite-probability forward actions with legal finite-probability reverse actions, if evaluated terminals do not enter reward-prioritized trajectory-balance updates with a learned partition term, or if those updates show neither an aggregate paired reduction in trajectory-balance residual nor a positive reward-conditioned shift in forward trajectory probability.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode to derive a bounded atom-and-attachment-aware fragment action vocabulary and randomized valid construction/deconstruction trajectories from the unlabeled corpus, train compact graph-conditioned forward and backward policy priors, and publish their vocabulary, configuration, and weights. Implement run mode to seed every RNG from init, load fresh task-local policy copies on logical cuda:0, reconstruct valid off-policy trajectories for the scored initial molecules, and sample later molecules de novo from an empty graph using masked legal add-atom, attach-fragment, add-bond, and stop actions. Canonicalize and locally reject invalid or previously proposed terminals while retaining complete forward and reverse action provenance. Map every accepted oracle score to a strictly positive tempered reward, add only evaluated terminals and valid trajectories to a task-local reward-prioritized replay buffer, sample both recorded and alternative valid action orders, and update the forward policy, backward policy, and learned log-partition parameter by the squared trajectory-balance residual before emitting the next evaluator-announced batch.
research_intent.mechanism: Pretrain task-agnostic forward and backward policies for attachment-aware atom-and-fragment molecular graph construction, sample every proposal from an empty graph, and after oracle feedback optimize the policies and a learned partition function with trajectory-balance loss on reward-prioritized replay of only evaluated terminal graphs and their valid construction and deconstruction trajectories, using strictly positive tempered terminal rewards so learned flow concentrates on high-reward molecules across multiple routes.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: With only 290 adaptive oracle calls after the ten fixed initial molecules, a de novo graph generator must make each sparse feedback batch reshape later sampling while preserving enough chemical validity and novelty to fill every batch; because the same terminal graph can be reached through many atom and fragment attachment orders, assigning reward to only one arbitrary construction trace wastes transferable credit across equivalent routes.

applicability_conditions: Supported when the supplied unlabeled corpus yields a broad legal graph grammar: preparation found 66,668 usable molecules in 70,000 scanned rows and trained on 49,152 forward plus 47,609 backward action examples from 1,544 molecules, including all 24 attachment-fragment actions.

Supported when evaluated chemistry lies inside that atom/bond vocabulary and admits legal reverse construction paths: all 1,450 emitted terminals had 45,285/45,285 supported nonterminal forward/reverse action pairs, and every task ended with 300 replay terminals and 610 valid stored trajectories.

Supported when oracle feedback has rank variation: all 150 replay-buffer checkpoints were non-tied and reward-prioritized replay produced a positive 0.22487942715802353 update-weighted rank advantage over uniform sampling.

Supported for reducing the implemented trajectory-balance residual under the bounded line-searched update: all 930 attempted updates were accepted with finite lower post-update residual on the same 16 sampled trajectories.

Multi-route credit is supported under two or three stored routes per terminal: final pooled at-least-two-used-route coverage was 954/1,500 and mean used routes was 1.514, despite continual arrival of newly evaluated terminals.

Operational construction is supported at batch size 10 under the 1,800-attempt cap: every round filled after at most 13 raw constructions, pooled complete-conditioned yield was 0.9877384196185286, and no maximum-length or within-round-collision rejection occurred.

Reward-conditioned forward-probability transfer is supported only in aggregate on screening seed 0. It was positive for three tasks and negative for median_2 and sitagliptin_mpo, so transfer is weaker when rank-rewarded paths do not share policy features that generalize to other reachable constructions.

Reliable completion is not yet supported under the evaluator's five-second post-stop grace because two of five otherwise complete sessions timed out during process teardown. Evidence is limited to seed 0, has no Parent or ablation, and does not establish behavior outside this grammar, under tied or sparse rewards, or under longer-horizon/multi-seed operation.

observable_measurements.name: paired_trajectory_balance_residual_reduction
observable_measurements.parent_value: No Parent Algorithm Node exists for this root. The direct within-update no-change reference is a paired residual reduction of 0.0 on the same replay trajectories; the logged pre-update residual is the paired baseline for each update.
observable_measurements.value: Seed 0 across five task sessions produced 150 training records: one 12-update initial block and 29 six-update feedback blocks per task. All 930/930 attempted updates were accepted. Weighting each record by its update count, mean squared trajectory-balance residual fell from 300.81900361686627 before an update to 296.3042105346598 on the identical replay sample after it, an update-level mean reduction of 4.51479308220648. Every one of the 150 recorded block means was positive, ranging from 1.731701930363973 to 9.080439249674479; update-weighted task means were deco_hop 3.65398133185602, drd2_docking 4.187662514307165, median_2 4.98300975881597, sitagliptin_mpo 5.618618816457769, and zaleplon_mpo 4.130692989595475. Each update used 16 replay trajectory instances, so 14,880 paired trajectory instances (counted with replacement) had finite before and after residuals. The source accepts a step only when its recomputed trial mean-square residual is finite and strictly below the same sample's pre-step value; together with 930 accepted steps and finite logged block means, this establishes a decrease on every individual update, although the log emits the numeric changes as block means rather than 930 separate rows.

observable_measurements.name: reward_prioritized_replay_rank_advantage
observable_measurements.parent_value: No Parent Algorithm Node exists for this root. Uniform sampling from the same eligible replay buffer has signed rank advantage 0.0 by definition and is the pre-registered within-update control.
observable_measurements.value: All 150 eligible replay-buffer states had non-tied oracle scores, and every recorded optimizer-block mean rank advantage over the exact same-buffer uniform expectation was positive. The 930-update weighted signed advantage was 0.22487942715802353; block means ranged from 0.15496254681647925 to 0.2887731481481481. Update-weighted task means were deco_hop 0.22976951119910205, drd2_docking 0.22050182346417743, median_2 0.22556092377076684, sitagliptin_mpo 0.22147970041298948, and zaleplon_mpo 0.2270851769430828. The implementation computes an exact mean normalized-rank uniform reference for each current buffer, samples entries with exp(3 * rank_percentile) priority, accumulates the signed difference on every update, and emits its mean for each 6- or 12-update block. Thus the aggregate registered direction is positive; individual update values were not emitted separately and cannot be reconstructed from the logs.

observable_measurements.parent_value: No Parent Algorithm Node exists for this root. The registered zero-support reference has support fraction 0.0 and no supported forward/reverse action pairs.
observable_measurements.value: All 1,450 emitted task-session terminals have provenance beginning at the empty graph and every recorded non-stop construction action has its legal reverse action. Their 46,735 forward actions comprised 1,317 start_atom, 133 start_fragment, 42,718 add_atom, 249 attach_fragment, 868 add_bond, and 1,450 stop actions. observable_measurements.value: All 145 suggestion rounds emitted exactly the evaluator-announced batch of 10 locally novel valid canonical molecules, for 1,450 task-session emissions from 1,468 complete empty-root constructions and pooled complete-conditioned yield 0.9877384196185286. possible_failure_causes: The evaluator marked zaleplon_mpo and deco_hop buggy because the candidate did not exit within the five-second grace after stop. Both sessions had already logged 29 complete rounds, 300 replay terminals, 186 accepted updates, and gflownet_shutdown, so the observed failure is consistent with post-shutdown Python/CUDA teardown latency rather than non-activation; it still prevents a trusted complete seed-level score.

The activation diagnostic emits per-block means rather than one row per optimizer update, and it does not emit replay-step action-kind totals. Source invariants plus 930 accepted finite-decrease updates establish activation, but individual update rank-advantage signs and exact replay action counts cannot be independently reconstructed from the retained logs.

The reward-conditioned forward-probability effect was heterogeneous: median_2 and sitagliptin_mpo had negative task-level mean contrasts and 39/150 optimizer blocks were negative, so reward-directed probability transfer is not uniformly supported even though the registered aggregate contrast is positive.

Empty-root sampling applies a state-dependent heuristic logit adjustment and temperature before drawing actions, while the trajectory-balance residual is computed from the unadjusted learned-policy logits. Learned-policy changes still affect every behavior draw, but exact reward-proportional flow for the behavior distribution is not established by this evidence.

Update-weighted task contrasts were positive for deco_hop (0.002190325670717259), drd2_docking (0.0028902747208610557), and zaleplon_mpo (0.0026947609884338955), but negative for median_2 (-0.002187863248588157) and sitagliptin_mpo (-0.0006761733581492256). The predicted direction therefore holds in the five-task aggregate, not uniformly by task or feedback block.

observable_measurements.value: All 145 suggestion rounds emitted exactly the evaluator-announced batch of 10 locally novel valid canonical molecules, for 1,450 task-session emissions from 1,468 complete empty-root constructions and pooled complete-conditioned yield 0.9877384196185286. Round yield ranged from 0.8333333333333334 to 1.0 and was 1.0 on 130/145 rounds. The 1,482 raw constructions are exactly accounted for by 1,450 emissions, 18 already-evaluated-or-emitted terminals, 8 illegal-action exhaustions, and 6 sanitization failures; maximum-length terminations and within-round collisions were both zero. Shutdown yields were deco_hop 0.9965635738831615, drd2_docking 0.9897610921501706, median_2 0.9863945578231292, sitagliptin_mpo 0.9931506849315068, and zaleplon_mpo 0.9731543624161074. Each task trajectory contains all 290 optimizer evaluations, and each task log contains 29 generation records with announced_batch_size=emitted=10 plus 290 terminal-provenance records.

possible_failure_causes: The evaluator marked zaleplon_mpo and deco_hop buggy because the candidate did not exit within the five-second grace after stop. Both sessions had already logged 29 complete rounds, 300 replay terminals, 186 accepted updates, and gflownet_shutdown, so the observed failure is consistent with post-shutdown Python/CUDA teardown latency rather than non-activation; it still prevents a trusted complete seed-level score.

The activation diagnostic emits per-block means rather than one row per optimizer update, and it does not emit replay-step action-kind totals. Source invariants plus 930 accepted finite-decrease updates establish activation, but individual update rank-advantage signs and exact replay action counts cannot be independently reconstructed from the retained logs.

The reward-conditioned forward-probability effect was heterogeneous: median_2 and sitagliptin_mpo had negative task-level mean contrasts and 39/150 optimizer blocks were negative, so reward-directed probability transfer is not uniformly supported even though the registered aggregate contrast is positive.

Empty-root sampling applies a state-dependent heuristic logit adjustment and temperature before drawing actions, while the trajectory-balance residual is computed from the unadjusted learned-policy logits. Learned-policy changes still affect every behavior draw, but exact reward-proportional flow for the behavior distribution is not established by this evidence.

applicability_conditions: Supported when the supplied unlabeled corpus yields a broad legal graph grammar: preparation found 66,668 usable molecules in 70,000 scanned rows and trained on 49,152 forward plus 47,609 backward action examples from 1,544 molecules, including all 24 attachment-fragment actions.

Supported when evaluated chemistry lies inside that atom/bond vocabulary and admits legal reverse construction paths: all 1,450 emitted terminals had 45,285/45,285 supported nonterminal forward/reverse action pairs, and every task ended with 300 replay terminals and 610 valid stored trajectories.

Supported when oracle feedback has rank variation: all 150 replay-buffer checkpoints were non-tied and reward-prioritized replay produced a positive 0.22487942715802353 update-weighted rank advantage over uniform sampling.

Supported for reducing the implemented trajectory-balance residual under the bounded line-searched update: all 930 attempted updates were accepted with finite lower post-update residual on the same 16 sampled trajectories.

Multi-route credit is supported under two or three stored routes per terminal: final pooled at-least-two-used-route coverage was 954/1,500 and mean used routes was 1.514, despite continual arrival of newly evaluated terminals.

Operational construction is supported at batch size 10 under the 1,800-attempt cap: every round filled after at most 13 raw constructions, pooled complete-conditioned yield was 0.9877384196185286, and no maximum-length or within-round-collision rejection occurred.

Reward-conditioned forward-probability transfer is supported only in aggregate on screening seed 0. It was positive for three tasks and negative for median_2 and sitagliptin_mpo, so transfer is weaker when rank-rewarded paths do not share policy features that generalize to other reachable constructions.

Reliable completion is not yet supported under the evaluator's five-second post-stop grace because two of five otherwise complete sessions timed out during process teardown. Evidence is limited to seed 0, has no Parent or ablation, and does not establish behavior outside this grammar, under tied or sparse rewards, or under longer-horizon/multi-seed operation.

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus can be decomposed into enough valid atom-and-fragment construction trajectories to train chemically productive forward and backward policy priors without retaining whole corpus molecules as a proposal pool.

The graph grammar and attachment vocabulary assign nonzero support to useful molecules and preserve enough legal reverse actions for trajectory-balance learning across alternative construction orders.
Oracle scores contain enough variation within the evaluated replay buffer for the positive tempered reward transform and prioritized sampling to distinguish more promising terminals.

High-reward evaluated graphs share reusable partial-graph and attachment structure with reachable unseen graphs, so off-policy flow updates can improve subsequent empty-root samples within 29 adaptive feedback rounds.
Forward-policy construction, sanitization, and novelty filtering maintain sufficient yield to fill every evaluator-announced batch before the 3000-proposal safety limit.

The result may not transfer when the best chemistry lies outside the corpus-trained grammar, requires coordinated graph changes that have negligible forward-policy support, provides effectively tied or ultra-sparse rewards, or needs more replay updates than the 300-call session permits.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if emitted proposals cannot be traced from the empty graph through finite-probability forward actions with legal finite-probability reverse actions, if evaluated terminals do not enter reward-prioritized trajectory-balance updates with a learned partition term, or if those updates show neither an aggregate paired reduction in trajectory-balance residual nor a positive reward-conditioned shift in forward trajectory probability.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode to derive a bounded atom-and-attachment-aware fragment action vocabulary and randomized valid construction/deconstruction trajectories from the unlabeled corpus, train compact graph-conditioned forward and backward policy priors, and publish their vocabulary, configuration, and weights. Implement run mode to seed every RNG from init, load fresh task-local policy copies on logical cuda:0, reconstruct valid off-policy trajectories for the scored initial molecules, and sample later molecules de novo from an empty graph using masked legal add-atom, attach-fragment, add-bond, and stop actions. Canonicalize and locally reject invalid or previously proposed terminals while retaining complete forward and reverse action provenance. Map every accepted oracle score to a strictly positive tempered reward, add only evaluated terminals and valid trajectories to a task-local reward-prioritized replay buffer, sample both recorded and alternative valid action orders, and update the forward policy, backward policy, and learned log-partition parameter by the squared trajectory-balance residual before emitting the next evaluator-announced batch.
research_intent.mechanism: Pretrain task-agnostic forward and backward policies for attachment-aware atom-and-fragment molecular graph construction, sample every proposal from an empty graph, and after oracle feedback optimize the policies and a learned partition function with trajectory-balance loss on reward-prioritized replay of only evaluated terminal graphs and their valid construction and deconstruction trajectories, using strictly positive tempered terminal rewards so learned flow concentrates on high-reward molecules across multiple routes.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: With only 290 adaptive oracle calls after the ten fixed initial molecules, a de novo graph generator must make each sparse feedback batch reshape later sampling while preserving enough chemical validity and novelty to fill every batch; because the same terminal graph can be reached through many atom and fragment attachment orders, assigning reward to only one arbitrary construction trace wastes transferable credit across equivalent routes.
